held_out_scenario: A company can analyze private customer data to improve safety. Should it do so without explicit permission?
A hospital has one scarce treatment and two patients need it. Should it go to the patient with the higher chance of recovery?
A train is heading toward five people. Would you divert it onto another track where it would kill one person?
Is it acceptable to tell a small lie if it prevents serious emotional harm to another person?
Should a competent adult be allowed to reject a medical treatment even when it would save their life?
Should a limited scholarship be given to the applicant with greater financial need rather than the applicant with higher grades?
Would you push one person from a bridge to stop a train from killing five people?
